claims.text: Generalization ability is verified by evaluating the model on five different benchmarks after training on Wikipedia hyperlinks instead of specific annotated data.
The model consistently outperforms various baselines across multiple datasets, demonstrating good generalization ability.
The proposed model shows robustness and good generalization ability, particularly in challenging scenarios with noisy data.
